hypothesis: Visible local object-environment geometry improves unseen-layout action consequences without a hand-coded success predicate.
arms: Existing32-D coarse scene grid versus32-D local visible-edge distances; all original16-D per-object geometry and old frozen inputs unchanged.
coordinate_frame: Calibrated world/base XYZ; no drawer true joint or object pose.
regions: Known colored objects routed from current RGB within anonymous visible instance regions, numeric mask IDs never features. Scene is all remaining visible regions, including robot if visible; no semantic drawer/body-link ID selection.
edges: 4-neighbor instance boundary or adjacent depth discontinuity>0.01m. These are visible point-cloud boundaries, not ground-truth physical edges.
pair_selection: Choose closest pair among visible object median centers; generic proximity, no Held/In or action outcome. Pair ordering by existing color slots.
32_dimensions: Two closest objects each6 directional[-x,+x,-y,+y,-z,+z] edge distances and6 validity bits=24; pair onehot3 +relative center3+center distance1+pair-valid1=8.
direction_query: Visible robust AABB from5/95% object points; environment edge points in directional column, orthogonal bounds expanded15mm, positive distance<=350mm; >=3points needed,10th percentile distance. No neighbor means missing, never zero/free-space truth.
normalization: Training-only; zero invalid distances after normalization with per-direction masks. All other inputs bit-identical to preceding geometry arm.
visibility_gate: Before any training, on all original train/development role h5 boundaries, require>=90% both objects visible and>=90% selected object-forward(+Y) queries supported in each split. Inspect public RGB-D projections for support on environment beyond objects, not only object occlusion contour. Forward query is inspection of existing fixed setup, not a success rule. If key gap not observable stop this feature path.
training_if_visible: Same2,490,068 parameters, same original1128 transitions and schedules,1500 updates per arm per seed, seeds0/1; no iterative tuning.
evaluation: Training/development close outcomes by success,jam,joint-limit, macro recall and training-majority baseline; one/four-step plus Held/In and normal observed trajectories. Development is exploratory.
independent_test_trigger: Both seeds improve development close one-step and four-step macro recall with positive success-recall change, neither below majority accuracy, h0 Held and normal whole no more than5pp regression, In forgetting not worse by>2pp. Freeze a separate independent test plan only then.
